question: What structural division of the teaching is sought to be fully known?
premises: The teaching contains a division into groups of eight.
This division is the object of inquiry.
The speaker seeks to know it fully and without limit.
inference: The speaker seeks to fully know the division into eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight groups of eight is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And to know fully and endlessly the division into the eight groups of eight.
